top_signals.title: Fake freight broker redirects $273K seafood shipment in New Jersey cargo theft attempt
top_signals.summary:
A series of phone calls and text messages appeared to come from a trusted freight broker. The driver followed those instructions, unaware of what awaited at the destination. Investigators uncovered a cargo theft scheme that raises questions about shipment verification and broker impersonation.

The post Fake freight broker redirects $273K seafood shipment in New Jersey cargo theft attempt appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
